patterns.description: The public website directs users to an existing authorized portal.
A vendor provides an approved hosted interface or embedded component.
The website backend communicates with an authorized system through supported APIs.
Systems exchange events or notifications through approved mechanisms.
Systems exchange approved data files or batches on a defined schedule.
advantages: Can support systems without real-time APIs

standards_awareness.rule: Verify actual implementation, supported resources, profiles, versions, and authorization.

standards_awareness.purpose: Messaging commonly used in healthcare integrations.
standards_awareness.rule: Confirm message types, interfaces, and vendor specifications.
Use approved imaging infrastructure and access controls.

selection_rules: Prefer supported and documented integration methods.
Select patterns based on actual workflow requirements.
Consider security, reliability, latency, and maintainability.
Do not recommend direct production database access by default.
Require technical review before final integration selection.
